scope_note: Agent evidence review on 2026-10-16 inspected current main, recent batches, repository structure/instructions, task/claims, source/media and receipt schemas, the normal-fade profile, tests and CI. The data-quality skill shared dependency was unavailable, so repository audit/validation procedures supplied the fallback; no unsupported skill-completion claim. Remaining gaps: independently replicated genotype-specific maturity chemistry, calibrated organ-segmented images, same-flower longitudinal video and sample-level exclusion/diagnostic evidence. Ambiguous organ identity, uncalibrated color and sample-unlinked chemistry remain low-confidence human-review cases. Agent review is not human or laboratory verification. No production deployment or overall completion claimed.
